source: On a version of Nuxt without renderer plugins, {0} registers the same file as a Nitro plugin, which needs {1} with {2} in your module's {3}. Nitro calls it with its app, whose {4} are the ones the renderer calls, so the plugin works there too as long as it only reads {5}, registers only hooks that version calls, does not rely on the shape of the event, and imports nothing a server of that version cannot resolve. If it does, pass the Nitro plugin to register instead:
text: In einer Nuxt-Version ohne Renderer-Plugins registriert {0} dieselbe Datei als Nitro-Plugin, wofür {1} mit {2} in der {3} deines Moduls erforderlich ist.
